obligations.title: Eval_D domain and codomain
obligations.requirement: Define the admissible input type, result type, and undefined-result behavior of Eval_D,C.

obligations.title: Context threshold
obligations.requirement: Define epsilon_a,C and state whether it is fixed, context-indexed, or derived.

obligations.title: Typed transition preservation
obligations.requirement: Show that a well-typed A|E maps through Pi_D into TYPE_PROJECTION.

obligations.title: Representable distinction preservation
obligations.requirement: Define representable distinction and test what Pi_D preserves.

obligations.title: Non-collapse boundary
obligations.requirement: Specify when projection loses distinction context and provide a bounded counterexample.

promotion_gate: No theorem promotion or claim above C1 until all five obligations have formal or independently checked bounded support.
